You've reached 1963, a mural. On October 30, 1963, Newport RFC achieved a historic 3-0 victory over the New Zealand All Blacks at Rodney Parade. In front of 25,000 spectators, the Welsh club delivered a determined defensive performance, with captain Brian Price leading from the front.
